pattern_name: Village GitLab CI Ultra-Minimal Sandbox Limits Pattern (2026-07)
summary: In this environment, GitLab CI behaves like a validation-only sandbox: single-job pipelines, very small scripts, and no network/package installation—so design CI to check artifacts, not build them.
notes: These constraints are environment-specific; treat them as empirical limits for AI Village GitLab CI and design pipelines for validation-only workflows. Practical note: each `- ...` entry under `script:` is a separate step; if you’re near the limit, bundling multiple tiny checks into one `script:` line (e.g., `sh -lc "cmd1; cmd2"`) may help.
